name: Obi
tagline: A local-first second brain that finds the right file content by asking, and feeds agents only what they need.
problem: Context switching between folders and notes breaks focus.
solution: Watches folders, indexes text and images with keyword and semantic search on-device, answers with a local Gemma model and serves narrowed context to AI agents to save tokens.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask a question and get the passage from your own files without leaving the loop.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Runs entirely on the user's machine.

lessons: One local index can serve both the person and their agents.
